title: fix round: auto-merge review findings (gate the exact target sha, never ship after a red post-merge gate, merge-pending, revert gating)
spec:
Fix round for auto-merge (T-1678/T-1681/T-1683) after an independent full-diff security review (Planner-run,
2026-10-06, REQUEST_CHANGES; no push to main, no shell, no clobbering found; tests 109 OK). Work in
/Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/T-1683 on branch task/T-1683; add commits on top. Fix all of these:

H1 ship.py:178,188 gated_target_sha is read again after the push, but spawn.py:320 fetches origin in the same repo from
   the daemon thread, so main can move in between and an ungated tree gets merged while the post-merge check sees
   nothing. Read the target sha once (rev-parse origin/<target> right after the fetch), merge exactly that sha, store it
   as gated_target_sha; in _merging also require `git merge-base --is-ancestor <gated_target_sha> <gated_head_sha>`.
H2 ship.py:223-235, 342-347 once post_merge_gate == "red", _on_merged sets shipped (after a crash before or during the
   rollback, or after `ship --retry`). Never set shipped when post_merge_gate is red: run the rollback if none completed
   (record rollback state in pipeline.ship), otherwise hold "post-merge gate red, rollback failed". `ship --retry` refuses a
   goal whose PR is merged and red.
M3 ship.py:221-224 fetch failure -> first_parent None -> post-merge gate skipped -> shipped unverified. With
   gated_target_sha set and first_parent unresolved: error and hold, never ship.
M4 ship.py:368-397 the revert PR is gated on a stale origin/main and merged with only --match-head-commit. Fetch before
   merging, compare with the base sha the revert was gated on; moved -> re-gate once, still moving -> leave the PR open,
   notify.
M5 ship.py:213-216, 259-270 `gh pr merge` exit 0 but PR not MERGED (merge queue / auto-merge) loops forever (no stop
   event in --once). After exit 0 read the PR state; not MERGED -> hold "merge pending" and return.
L6 ship.py:276-279 errors only set last_error and re-run gating every tick. Count consecutive errors; hold with a notice
   after 3.
L7 ship.py:131-138, 253-258 a MERGED PR counts as shipped even if goal/<id> has commits after it. Shipped only if the
   merged PR's head contains the current goal head; otherwise open a new PR.
L8 ship.py:358-360 validate the rollback sha with ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ before any git call.
L9 .gitignore: add .orchestrator/ship-wt/ and .orchestrator/ship.lock.
L10 tests/_harness.py copies the live pool.toml with [ship].enabled = true: force enabled = false there (as for
   autonomous); fake gh and gate scripts create temp dirs under the test's own directory and clean them up.
One named test per item in tests/test_ship.py. Run in the foreground: PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest
tests.test_ship tests.test_cli tests.test_goals tests.test_daemon (pytest may be missing). Commit on task/T-1683.
acceptance: each of H1-H2, M3-M5, L6-L10 is fixed and has a named test in tests/test_ship.py
tests.test_ship, tests.test_cli, tests.test_goals and tests.test_daemon pass

result.summary:
I fixed all ten review items (H1-H2, M3-M5, L6-L10) and committed the work as `T-1688 ship: review fix round...` on `task/T-1688`. The acceptance run is not fully green: 3 of 366 tests fail, all in `tests.test_daemon`. The same 3 fail on the base commit with the same set run, and they pass when run alone, so they come from test ordering, not this change. The 36 ship tests (all new ones included) and the cli and goals tests pass.

The packet said to work in `wt/T-1683` on `task/T-1683`, but this session started in `wt/T-1688` on `task/T-1688`, which already holds the T-1683 commits. I committed there, as the run instructions say to use the current branch.

**What changed in ship.py**
- **H1:** `origin/<target>` is read once, right after the fetch. That sha is what gets merged into the goal branch and stored as `gated_target_sha`. `_merging` now also holds unless `gated_target_sha` is an ancestor of `gated_head_sha`.
- **H2:** a red post-merge gate never leads to shipped. The rollback status is saved in `pipeline.ship` as `running` before it starts. On resume, a rollback still marked `running` is run again; one that finished and failed holds with "post-merge gate red, rollback failed". `ship --retry` refuses a goal whose PR is merged with a red post-merge gate.
- **M3:** if `gated_target_sha` is set but the merge commit's first parent can't be resolved, the goal holds with "ship merge parent unresolved" instead of skipping the check.
- **M4:** the revert worktree starts from a fixed base sha. After the gate passes it fetches again. If the target moved, it merges the new target into the rollback branch, pushes (a normal push, not forced) and gates once more. If the target is still moving, the PR is left open with a notice. With `--force` the gate is skipped, so this check is skipped too.
- **M5:** if `gh pr merge` exits 0 but the PR isn't MERGED, the goal holds with "merge pending".
- **L6:** consecutive errors are counted in `pipeline.ship.errors`. The third holds with a notice ("ship failed 3 times in a row"). The count resets on reaching merging or shipped, and on retry.
- **L7:** a MERGED PR only counts as shipped if its head contains the current goal head. Otherwise the PR number is cleared and a new PR goes through gating.
- **L8:** `rollback` refuses anything that doesn't match `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$` before any git call.

**Other files**
- **L9:** `.gitignore` now covers `.orchestrator/ship-wt/` and `.orchestrator/ship.lock`.
- **L10:** `tests/_harness.py` forces `[ship].enabled = false`.
- In `tests/test_ship.py`, the fake gh and gate scripts now put their temp dirs under the test's own `tmp` dir and remove them. The fake gh also reports the PR head and can simulate a pending merge.

**One decision for you:** for H2 I don't re-run a rollback that finished and failed. Running it again could open a second revert PR. Say if you want it retried on resume instead.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/ship.py`, `tests/test_ship.py`, `tests/_harness.py`,
